title: Case workspace with routed tabs, evidence preview and review drawers
scope: Turn the case detail, evidence and review pages into one case workspace: page header with status chip and key-facts strip, routed tabs (Summary, Evidence, Relationships, Findings, Review), evidence list with a preview pane, and review actions (propose, approve, reject, withdraw, refer, request evidence) in right-side drawers with their existing confirmation dialogs

acceptance.text: Every tab has its own URL and fits the page-length budget at 1440x900; the review page no longer stacks the decision, the evidence-request form, suggestions and the trail in one column

All existing review rules hold: separation of duties, confirmation before every action, disabled actions state a reason, no decision without a human; existing DecisionPanel and review e2e tests pass or are updated with the same assertions
Selection reasons, processing state and sources use the TAX-150 product names; RSL values keep RSL labels

Screenshots at 1440, 1024 and 390px with loading, empty, error and denied states, keyboard/focus and axe results, and the TAX-144 page-length result; record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Updated component and Playwright tests on the fixture build

evidence.text: One case workspace (CaseWorkspaceView): routed tabs Summary /cases/:id, Evidence /evidence (and /evidence/:evidenceId in the preview pane), Relationships, Findings and Review, each its own URL with aria-current and back-button history; ?tab= links redirect. Page length at 1440x900: Summary 1.00, Evidence 1.03, evidence record 1.31, Relationships 1.48, Findings 1.42 (was 1.95), Review 1.46 (was 2.26); the TAX-148 over-budget entries are removed from tests/frontend/support/layout-baseline.json and layout.spec.ts passes. The review tab no longer stacks forms: decision state, evidence requests and trail beside the suggestions, with the propose and request-evidence forms in right-side drawers.

Review rules unchanged: DecisionPanel keeps the API calls, Idempotency-Keys, expected versions and refusals; separation of duties, confirmation before every action (ConfirmActionDialog over the drawer, Escape keeps the draft), disabled actions with reasons and no decision without a human hold. DecisionPanel.test.ts (8) updated for the drawers with the same assertions; apps/auditor-web/e2e review.spec, evidence.spec, smoke.spec and review-mobile-a11y.spec updated; auditor e2e 66 passed; scenario and onboarding specs updated for routed tabs and drawers.

Selection reasons, processing state and sources use the TAX-150 register (Vati records, Investigation, Document reading, Explore, Name screening, Vati assistant); service identifiers are ProvenanceValue; RSL values keep RSL labels; the browser naming check finds 0 names on every case tab.

docs/evidence/TAX-148: 39 screenshots at 1440/1024/390 (each tab, evidence preview, review, propose drawer, confirmation over the drawer, loading/empty/error/denied); tests/frontend/case-workspace.spec.ts 15 passed (axe, keyboard focus into drawers and back, product names, page-length budget); npm run check passes; full frontend suite 304 passed, 11 failed (9 demo-recording harness needing a separate demo stack; onboarding keyboard and SYN-003 failed once at 390 under load and pass 3/3 alone).
